TAL_DARK_ROLLING_BLACKOUT.why: Use an Action or Bonus Action to move one selected Darkness area up to 30 feet, staying within 120 feet of you. Eternal Darkness and Darkness clinging to a creature stay put.

TAL_UNMAKING_SPLINTERING_TRACE.why: Only when Black Trace hits an object, construct, armor, shield, barrier or temporary qi structure; the table has no objects or barriers as targets and no creature types (the GM applies the extra d10s).

TAL_UNMAKING_CRACK_THE_GUARD.why: On a Ruin Channel hit against a creature using a shield or other defensive implement: the table doesn't track shield AC apart from armour, or Cracks on gear (the GM applies the save and its result).

TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_BORROWED_MOMENTUM.why: Triggers when one of your Flowing River talents moves a creature; the table's Flowing River talents knock Prone or deny movement but moving a creature (Court of Returning Water's 10 feet) is the GM's, so the GM applies the choice.

tianxia.path.qi_cultivation.feature.qi_s.why: Passive Qi Sensing is a sense (senses are being built); Analyze Qi's information is the GM's to give -- the action posts it as a GM line.

TAL_VOID_VOID_TRAINING.why: Void Needle, a free Void talent and a default Void damage type (Force, Necrotic or Psychic) are chosen when the sphere is learned.

tianxia.talent.disease.enlarged_quaranti.why: It enlarges Quarantine Veil, the Disease sphere's base ability; a character without that ability gains nothing from it.

TAL_DARK_CONTESTING_LIGHT.why: A Radiance area made inside another's Darkness: its maker's Cultivation Check against the Darkness maker's save DC; success removes the Darkness (combat/ext/tabik_dark.py). The failed check's "ordinary light" is not modelled (no lighting on the table).

TAL_DARK_OBFUSCATION.why: Scrying and divination are used away from the table's fights, not during them. The printed 1 CP is still charged and the printed effect is posted as a GM rider when the augment is used: creatures and objects inside the Darkness cannot be located through ordinary scrying or divination. The table runs no scrying for that ruling to resolve, so it is settled between the player and the GM between fights, and the table now says so instead of taking the point in silence (combat/ext/tabik_dark.py obfuscation_is_a_rider).
